description: The pie chart represents the distribution of articles across different years. The chart is divided into three slices, representing the years 2017, 2018, and 2019, colored green, orange, and blue, respectively. The slice for 2019 is the largest, occupying approximately 46% of the chart, followed by 2018 at around 33%, and 2017 at about 21%. Each slice is labeled with its corresponding year and percentage, along with a numerical value in parentheses, likely representing the number of articles. There is no legend, but the percentage labels are shown inside each slice. The slices are arranged in a clockwise order from largest to smallest, with no slice visually emphasized.
